versions.name: Totemic Carvings
versions.text: If this is {{KW:GENERATED}} by {{CARD:545|1}}, look at 6 6-{{COST}} monsters and choose one to give -6 {{COST}}. Add all of them to your hand.

versions.name: Totemic Carvings
versions.text: Look at 7 7-cost monsters (except Totem). Choose one, set its cost to 0, then add all of them to your hand.

versions.name: Totemic Carvings
versions.text: Look at 7 7-cost monsters (except Totem). Choose one to add to your hand and set its cost to 0.

versions.name: Totemic Carvings
versions.text: Look at 6 random different 6-cost monsters (except Totem). Choose one to add to your hand and set its cost to 0.

versions.name: Totemic Carvings
versions.text: Look at 7 different 7-{{COST}} monsters (except {{CARD:545|1}}). Choose one to add to your hand with -7 {{COST}}.

versions.name: Totemic Carvings
versions.text: Look at 7 random non-{{RARITY:DETERMINATION}} 7-{{COST}} monsters (except {{CARD:545|1}}). Choose one to add to your hand with -7 {{COST}}.
